components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The full-measure dominant action for an operational task.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { align-items:center; background:#078d91; border:0; border-radius:12px; box-shadow:0 8px 20px color-mix(in srgb,#078d91 20%,transparent); color:#fff; cursor:pointer; display:flex; font-family:'Atkinson HP',sans-serif; font-size:1rem; font-weight:700; justify-content:center; min-height:58px; padding:14px 20px; position:relative; transition:background-color 160ms ease,box-shadow 160ms ease,transform 160ms ease; width:100%; } .ds-btn-primary svg { height:19px; position:absolute; right:20px; width:19px; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#067b7f; box-shadow:0 10px 24px color-mix(in srgb,#078d91 25%,transparent); transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { box-shadow:0 4px 12px color-mix(in srgb,#078d91 18%,transparent); transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,#078d91 72%,white); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A visibly labelled, full-measure operational field.
components.css: .ds-field { color:#19282d; display:grid; font-family:'Atkinson HP',sans-serif; gap:8px; max-width:650px; } .ds-field>span { align-items:center; display:flex; font-size:.92rem; font-weight:700; justify-content:space-between; } .ds-field em { color:#59686c; font-size:.68rem; font-style:normal; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.06em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-field input { background:#fff; border:1px solid #9babad; border-radius:12px; color:#19282d; font:inherit; min-height:58px; padding:14px 17px; transition:border-color 160ms ease,box-shadow 160ms ease; width:100%; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color:#59686c; } .ds-field input:focus { border-color:#078d91; box-shadow:0 4px 18px color-mix(in srgb,#078d91 13%,transparent); outline:0; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,#078d91 72%,white); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Context Item
components.description: A compact factual support note with a softly colored icon tile.
components.html:
Need help?

Use a short, truthful explanation that supports the current task.
components.css: .ds-context-item { align-items:flex-start; color:#19282d; display:flex; font-family:'Atkinson HP',sans-serif; gap:16px; max-width:440px; padding:18px 0; } .ds-context-icon { align-items:center; background:#d8eeee; border-radius:12px; color:#067b7f; display:flex; flex:0 0 auto; height:44px; justify-content:center; width:44px; } .ds-context-icon svg { height:22px; width:22px; } .ds-context-item h3 { font-family:'Spline HP',sans-serif; font-size:1.08rem; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:-.015em; margin:1px 0 7px; } .ds-context-item p { color:#59686c; font-size:.9rem; line-height:1.5; margin:0; max-width:36ch; }

components.name: Raised Summary
components.description: A discrete handled object for account, invitation, or system facts.
components.css: .ds-raised-summary { background:#fff; border-radius:14px; box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(21,36,40,.09); color:#19282d; font-family:'Atkinson HP',sans-serif; max-width:500px; padding:24px; } .ds-raised-summary>strong { color:#14344e; font-family:'Spline HP',sans-serif; font-size:1.3rem; } .ds-raised-summary dl { border-top:1px solid #ccd6d6; display:grid; gap:10px; margin:18px 0 0; padding-top:16px; } .ds-raised-summary dl div { display:flex; gap:18px; justify-content:space-between; } .ds-raised-summary dt { color:#59686c; } .ds-raised-summary dd { font-weight:600; margin:0; } .ds-raised-summary:focus-within { outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,#078d91 72%,white); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Attention Notice
components.description: A restrained inline notice for caution or important task context.
components.html:
Keep this information safe

You may need it to regain access later.
components.css: .ds-notice-attention { background:#fff2dc; border-radius:12px; color:#19282d; font-family:'Atkinson HP',sans-serif; padding:17px 18px; } .ds-notice-attention strong { display:block; } .ds-notice-attention p { color:#59686c; font-size:.86rem; line-height:1.45; margin:6px 0 0; } .ds-notice-attention:focus-visible { outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,#b9781e 72%,white); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Compact Identity Header
components.description: The quiet product lockup and current surface location above operational content.
components.css: .ds-identity-header { align-items:center; background:#fbfcfc; border-bottom:1px solid #ccd6d6; color:#19282d; display:flex; font-family:'Atkinson HP',sans-serif; min-height:76px; padding:12px 48px; } .ds-identity { align-items:center; display:inline-flex; font-family:'Spline HP',sans-serif; font-size:1.22rem; font-weight:600; gap:10px; letter-spacing:-.025em; } .ds-identity img { height:44px; object-fit:contain; width:44px; } .ds-location { align-items:baseline; border-left:1px solid #ccd6d6; display:flex; gap:10px; margin-left:24px; padding-left:24px; } .ds-location small { color:#59686c; font-size:.78rem; font-weight:600; } .ds-location b { color:#14344e; font-size:.88rem; font-weight:700; } .ds-identity-header:focus-within { outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,#078d91 72%,white); outline-offset:-3px; }

narrative.overview:
HomePortal is a polished, neutral control surface for one household. It should feel calm enough to live with every day and exact enough to trust with infrastructure: cool neutral fields carry most of every screen, typography makes the current task unmistakable, and the unchanged house/server mark supplies identity without ornamental brand theater.

This is an operational dashboard world, not a civic register and not a navy-drenched developer console. Open canvases, restrained structure, softly eased controls, and factual supporting context keep attention on the work. Teal marks action, navy selectively anchors hierarchy, and amber appears only when something genuinely needs attention. Light and dark are equal expressions of the same system.
keyCharacteristics: Cool neutral surfaces occupy roughly 80–90% of each interface.
One dominant task or reading path is paired with quiet, truthful context.
Spline HP names products, screens, and sections; Atkinson HP handles operation and explanation.
Teal actions, selective navy structure, and restrained amber attention create hierarchy without color flooding.
Soft 12–14px geometry and low ambient depth make interactive objects feel precise and approachable.
The existing HomePortal logo remains unchanged and leads identity treatments.

rules.name: The Neutral Majority Rule
rules.body: Cool neutrals occupy roughly 80–90% of a screen. Accent color must clarify action, structure, or state.

rules.name: The Three-Accent Rule
rules.body: Teal acts, navy structures, and amber alerts. Do not exchange their jobs or let them compete in the same region.

rules.name: The Equal Themes Rule
rules.body: Dark mode uses charcoal and graphite surfaces with retuned accents; it is not an inverted light palette or a navy flood.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Spline names the place, object, or task; Atkinson explains and operates it. Add no novelty or decorative face.

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Rule
rules.body: Actions, navigation, headings, and prose use sentence case. Uppercase is limited to short metadata labels.

rules.name: The Open Canvas Rule
rules.body: Put the main task directly on the canvas. Containers are for discrete objects, not for wrapping an entire page or form by habit.

rules.name: The One Clear Task Rule
rules.body: The task or primary operational reading path always receives the strongest type, broadest useful measure, and first responsive position.

rules.name: The Ambient-Only Rule
rules.body: Shadows stay soft, cool, and low contrast. Never use hard drop shadows, stacked elevation, glow as decoration, or shadow around whole page regions.

rules.name: The Soft Precision Rule
rules.body: Use 12px for handled controls, 14px for discrete objects, and 8px for compact utilities. Radius softens interaction; it does not turn every content group into a card.

rules.name: The Current-State Rule
rules.body: Switches for persistent modes such as theme display the current state through their visible icon or label, like a physical light switch. The accessible name may additionally explain the action that will occur when activated.

dos: Do let cool neutral surfaces carry roughly 80–90% of each interface.
Do make one operational task or reading path unmistakably dominant and left aligned.
Do use teal for action, navy for selective structure, and amber for attention.
Do pair Spline headings with Atkinson controls and prose using the shipped self-hosted fonts.
Do preserve the existing HomePortal logo artwork, aspect ratio, and transparent surround.
Do build equal light and dark themes, using charcoal and graphite rather than navy flooding in dark mode.
Do retain accessible focus, 58px controls, responsive stacking, factual context, and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't revive the old green civic-register, mineral-paper, ledger-line, or public-service visual language.
Don't turn HomePortal into a navy-drenched developer dashboard, neon console, or generic smart-home tile grid.
Don't wrap the primary task in a floating card or place every content group inside a rounded container.
Don't use amber as a general brand fill, teal as decoration, or semantic red and green for ordinary emphasis.
Don't redraw, simplify, recolor, or replace the supplied logo.
Don't add glass effects, loud gradients, hard shadows, paper texture, decorative nostalgia, or gratuitous motion.
Don't canonize route-specific authentication copy or prototype fixture data as product-wide behavior.
